== Biography ==
Mary was born in 1834. She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-835|Robert Glasgow]]. She passed away in 1919.
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-835]] is assessed at 88% (probable). The held family account identifies Mary (Glasgow) Stewart as Robert Barclay Glasgow’s child, generally with Phebe McFall. Mary has Faris p 89 and 1850/1860 censuses, a stronger family reconstruction than memorial alone.

Confidence concerns this recorded child and the selected father as identified by the held family evidence; maternity and the father’s upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Inspect the child’s earliest household and the cited Faris page or original gravestone parent inscription.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-2223 Faris, David, The Glasgow Family of Adams County, Ohio (Baltimore, MD, Gateway Press, Inc., 1990), p.89]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.

=== Father relationship: Faris family review — 24 October 2026 ===

The existing father [[Glasgow-835|Robert Barclay Glasgow]] is now assessed at 94% (confident), up from 88% on 22 October 2026. This review supersedes the earlier father grade above.

Faris names Mary Jane as Robert and Phoebe’s child, born 26 May 1835, with first husband Robert Stewart Glasgow and second husband John H. Stewart. The same day/month and distinctive two-husband sequence identify the existing Mary-2223 account despite its 1834 birth year. Taken together these identifiers support confident paternal inference. The actual Faris pp. 46–47 were visually checked. They explicitly group these children under Robert Barclay Glasgow and Phoebe McFall; Robert’s own dates, two wives and Ohio–Iowa life identify the father account. These exact percentages are subjective assessments of each complete father/profile pair, not statistical measurements.<ref name="FarisRobertChildren1990">David Faris, ''The Glasgow Family of Adams County, Ohio'' (Baltimore: Gateway Press,1990), [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3Q9M-CS3J-H9F6-3 printed pp. 46–47], DGS 007834162,image 1583; actual printed pages visually checked 24 October 2026. Retrospective genealogy; original family and census records not inspected. The Bible provenance on p. 32 concerns the previous generation and is not asserted for this child list.</ref>

The 1834/1835 birth-year discrepancy remains unresolved and visible. It does not outweigh the full marital identity, but reduces confidence below a near-certain grade. Preserve 1834 in the existing vital field; no source is silently harmonized. The cited p. 89 and original censuses were not newly inspected. This is one retrospective compiled family history. Its list, reported censuses, modern family fields and memorial citations may share evidence; repeated details are not independent proofs. No original birth register, census, Bible or burial record was newly inspected. The 1927 Bible provenance on p. 32 concerns William and Rhoda’s children, not the dates of Robert’s next generation; it is not transferred here. Existing named fathers remain selected. Mothers are separate, ungraded or unselected where previously so. No new parent attachment, merge or live save.
